# Crisp Video

> Crisp Video restores, denoises and upscales old, low-res video to 4K offline on a Mac, then lets you edit it on a real timeline. Free with a small “Made with Crisp” mark; Pro is $129 once, not a subscription. macOS 26.0 or later, Apple Silicon (M1 or later).

## Product and pricing
- [Crisp Video](https://crispvideo.app/): what it does, real before/after clips, and the free download
- [Pricing](https://crispvideo.app/#pricing): Free — the full editor and the standard enhancement lanes, exports carry a small “Made with Crisp” mark. Pro — $129 once, every 1.x update included; removes the mark and adds the generative Max lane and batch processing
- [Founding price](https://crispvideo.app/#buy): $64.50 for the first 25 buyers (50% off) — the Buy button applies FOUNDINGCRISP at checkout; if it ever doesn't, choose “Have a discount code?” and enter it
- [Pay in four](https://crispvideo.app/#buy): Klarna or Afterpay at checkout in the US — $129 as 4 payments of $32.25, two weeks apart (founding: 4 × $16.13)
- [System requirements](https://crispvideo.app/#download): macOS 26.0 or later; Apple Silicon (M1 or later)
- [Licence terms](https://crispvideo.app/legal/terms/): one Pro licence runs on up to 3 Macs at a time
- [Refunds](https://crispvideo.app/legal/refunds/): email within 30 days of purchase for a refund, no reason needed
- [Download for Mac](https://github.com/mattkerr09/crisp-site/releases/download/v1/Crisp.dmg): the current release, 1.0.1440
- [FAQ](https://crispvideo.app/#faq): memory, speed, the Max lane, privacy, licensing

## Learn
- [Learn: video restoration explained](https://crispvideo.app/learn/): how video restoration and upscaling actually work
- [Is Topaz Video AI free? (2026) — what it costs now, and the free options on a Mac](https://crispvideo.app/learn/is-topaz-video-ai-free/): No: Topaz Video, formerly Video AI, is a subscription — $299 a year or $59 a month — and its pricing page lists no free plan.
- [AI video upscaling redraws detail a resize can't, and it's a guess every time](https://crispvideo.app/learn/what-is-ai-video-upscaling/): Measured on real frames halved and upscaled back: a plain resize kept pixels and colour most exactly but restored at most 64% of the fine detail; a heavier AI model restored up to 96%, by drawing it.
- [Why Topaz ended perpetual licences (and what it costs now)](https://crispvideo.app/learn/why-topaz-ended-perpetual-licences/): Topaz Labs stopped selling perpetual licences on 3 October 2025.
- [Why VHS tapes degrade, and what can still be recovered](https://crispvideo.app/learn/why-vhs-tapes-degrade/): Magnetic tape loses signal whether you play it or not.
- [What is interlacing, and why does old video have comb teeth?](https://crispvideo.app/learn/what-is-interlacing/): Those horizontal comb teeth on moving objects in old footage are interlacing.

## How-to guides
- [How-to guides for video on a Mac](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/): every guide, by task
- [How to restore old film footage on a Mac (2026) — remove dust and flicker, offline](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/restore-old-film-footage-mac/): Clean up an old film or video transfer on a Mac — remove single-frame dust and blotches, steady the brightness flicker, and upscale.
- [How to fix pixelated video on a Mac (2026) — what an upscaler recovers, measured](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/fix-pixelated-video-mac/): Pixelated video is missing detail, so no setting turns the blocks off.
- [How to upscale video on a Mac (2026) — free, offline, no cloud](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-video-on-mac/): A step-by-step guide to upscaling video to 4K on a Mac — 100% offline, no subscription, no account.
- [How to fix blurry video on a Mac (2026) — what works and what can't](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/fix-blurry-video-mac/): Blurry video has four different causes and only some are fixable.
- [How to upscale 480p to 1080p on a Mac (2026)](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-480p-to-1080p-mac/): 480p to 1080p is a realistic 2.25x jump that usually looks genuinely better.
- [How to upscale a finished edit to 4K on a Mac (2026) — offline, one export](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/upscale-a-finished-edit-to-4k-mac/): Edit your video on a timeline and upscale the whole finished cut to 4K in one export with Crisp — Enhance or generative SeedVR2 Max, 100% offline.
- [How to batch upscale videos on a Mac (2026)](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/batch-upscale-videos-mac/): Batching is mostly about not discovering a mistake 200 files in.
- [How to stabilize a shaky video on a Mac (2026) — steady handheld footage, free](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/stabilize-shaky-video-mac/): Stabilize shaky, handheld video on a Mac — Crisp tracks the motion and counter-shifts each frame to steady it, 100% offline.
- [Removing wind noise from video on a Mac: the rumble drops 13 dB, the voice stays](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/remove-wind-noise-from-video-mac/): Measured on Crisp's Wind mode: the low rumble that is 85% of wind noise falls 12.9 dB while the voice moves 0.2 dB.
- [How to compress a video on a Mac (2026) — free, offline, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/compress-video-on-mac/): Compress a video on a Mac to make the file smaller for email or upload — one tap, 100% offline, nothing uploaded.
- [How to convert MOV to MP4 on a Mac (2026) — free, offline, no upload](https://crispvideo.app/how-to/convert-mov-to-mp4-mac/): Convert a MOV (or AVI/MKV/WebM) to MP4 on a Mac in one tap, 100% offline — no upload, no subscription.
